question: Where was the Formula One 2013 Indian Grand Prix held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Buddh International Circuit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first Indian Grand Prix was held at the Buddha International circuit on 30th October 2011.
 
• The Indian Grand Prix was a Formula One (F1) race in the calendar of the FIA Formula One Championship, which was held at the Buddha International circuit in sector 25 along Yamuna Expressway in Gautam Buddha district of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• It happened from 2011 to 2013, Sebastian Vittel won all three times.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
